_comment: Seed rows for the compliance calendar. Two kinds. 'clock' obligations are event-driven and have a verified duration taken from the instrument — these are safe to state. 'recurring' obligations fall due on a date that varies by provider, by regulator notice or by state contract: every one carries verifyLocally: true and the source to check. NEVER write a due date from this file into a deliverable without checking it. A calendar with a confidently wrong date is worse than a calendar with a blank and a question.

clocks.trigger: Assessment completed and agreed fees paid
Significant event affecting compliance, or change of governing person
clocks.output: Notification to the Regulator, logged in the notifications register

clocks.trigger: A third party arrangement commences or concludes
clocks.output: Notification to the Regulator, third party register updated
No new enrolments accepted in the superseded product

clocks.trigger: A qualification is no longer current
clocks.output: Every enrolled student completed or transferred

clocks.trigger: A skill set, unit or accredited short course is no longer current
clocks.output: Every enrolled student completed or transferred

clocks.trigger: Last day a CRICOS course was delivered to an overseas student at a registered onshore location
clocks.output: Registration cancelled automatically. There is no output to produce — the only output is delivery.

recurring.name: Annual declaration on compliance
recurring.checkWith: asqanet / ASQA notice for the registration period
recurring.output: Submitted declaration, board minute recording the basis for signing it

recurring.name: Quality Indicator annual summary report
recurring.output: Submitted QI report plus the learner and employer questionnaire data behind it

recurring.name: Total VET activity / AVETMISS data submission
recurring.checkWith: NCVER collection notice, and the state training authority where a funding contract applies
recurring.output: Validated NAT files and the submission receipt

recurring.name: Public liability insurance renewal
recurring.checkWith: the certificate of currency on file

recurring.name: Registration renewal application window
recurring.checkWith: the registration expiry date on the National Register

recurring.name: Assessment validation, against the validation schedule
recurring.output: Dated validation record naming the validators, their credentials, the sample and the actions
recurring.indicator: products validated as a proportion of those scheduled to date

recurring.name: Industry engagement cycle
recurring.output: Dated engagement record naming who was consulted, what they said, and what changed as a result
recurring.indicator: training products with no engagement record in the last 12 months

recurring.name: Trainer credential and currency review
recurring.output: Updated trainer profile and currency matrix
recurring.indicator: days of runway to the next credential or currency expiry, per trainer, per product

recurring.name: Professional development cycle
recurring.output: PD plan and completion record per trainer, linked to what it changed in practice

recurring.name: Policy and procedure review
recurring.output: Version history showing the review happened and what changed
recurring.indicator: documents past their own review date

recurring.name: Self-assurance report to the governing body
recurring.output: Board or governance forum minute recording the indicators, the exceptions and the decisions taken
